title: Finite-prefix tensor projection for a normalized coefficient system
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a scheme $W$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme]. Work on its small pro-etale site with independent object, arrow and coefficient universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Write $A$ for the completed integral coefficient sheaf and $B_n=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi^{n+1})_W$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of actual coefficient sequence-site modules and finite coefficient modules, with exact evaluation $e_n$ [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site] and their closed tensor structures [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. Fix reduction data $R$ [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data], with representative normalizations as specified in [lem-coef-normalized-reduction-models]. Assume evaluation tensor normalization $h_E$. Let $M$ be a derived coefficient system satisfying $\mathrm{IsNormalizedCoefficientSequence}$, meaning that its actual horizontal reductions are invertible for every adjunction to the specified coefficient restriction. For each $n$, any $L\dashv e_n$ with unit $\eta$, and each finite derived object $P$, the adjunct of $(\eta_P\otimes 1_{e_nM})\,(R.\mathrm{evaluationTensor}(n))^{-1}_{LP,M}$ is invertible. Equivalently, the unit-defined projection $L(P\otimes e_nM)\longrightarrow LP\otimes M$ is an isomorphism. No internal Hom or normalized second argument is assumed.

theorem coefficientNormalizedEvaluationProjection
    (R : CoefficientDerivedSystemReduction l E W)
    (hE : CoefficientEvaluationTensorNormalization l E W R)
    (M : coefficientSequenceDerived l E W)
    (hM : IsNormalizedCoefficientSequence l E W M) (n : ℕ)
    (L : normalizedDVRDerived l E W n ⥤ coefficientSequenceDerived l E W)
    (adj : L ⊣ coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E W n)
    (P : normalizedDVRDerived l E W n) :
    IsIso ((adj.homEquiv _ _).symm
      ((R.finiteClosed n).tensor.map
          (Prod.mkHom (adj.unit.app P)
            (𝟙 ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E W n).obj M))) ≫
        (R.evaluationTensor n).inv.app (L.obj P, M)))
